stories.title: Trump visits Mamdani at Gracie Mansion
stories.summary: Trump met New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani at Gracie Mansion and told reporters afterward that Mamdani was "off to a start" on the way to becoming a "great mayor", while Mamdani stood beside him stone-faced. "Mayor Smiles refusing to smile while standing within 20 feet of trump will never not be funny" got 360K likes. Mamdani posted only "Had a productive meeting with the President today".
